subject: Absorb direct-to-final-layout loading as a general density optimization

body.text:
FREE TOKEN'S FTW/pin-after-fill bootstrap embodies a broader optimization law: do not load an intermediate representation only to discover, repack, copy and overwrite it. Store or derive hot artifacts directly in the runtime layout that the next stage consumes, and pin/map only after useful bytes are populated.

Search Bonfyre for repeated parse->repack->serialize->reload chains in hot physical paths. Candidate families include YaFF/CUE contract materialization, format finalizers, graph/index bodies, Arrow/Parquet/vector representations, evidence bundles, native command catalogs and model bodies.

Promote only where canonical semantics remain independently defined:
semantic object -> RepresentationRef(final-layout body)
rather than making physical layout canonical truth.

Measure: startup/load time, bytes copied, temporary bytes allocated, page faults, parse/repack CPU, and body reuse. Require one real before/after receipt with identical semantic digest and fewer physical operations.
